remarks: Light and Bright 2-Bed, 2-Bath Condo with South-Facing Balcony in Mid-City Stamford  Step into this light-filled, sophisticated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo, ideally located in the vibrant heart of Mid-City Stamford. With its expansive living and dining areas, and a bright, south-facing balcony offering stunning city views, this residence is designed to impress.  The parquet flooring adds a timeless touch, while the abundance of natural light enhances every corner of the space. Ample closets provide exceptional storage throughout, and the convenience of in-floor laundry makes daily life a breeze.  In this well-maintained doorman building, you'll enjoy the comfort of one-car garage parking and the ease of HOA covering heat, hot water, and cooking gas. Experience the perfect blend of modern living and convenience, just steps away from Stamford's top dining and entertainment.
